name: APT36 C2 1 - HTTP Beacons with Jitter to a Loopback Server (T1071.001)
blast_radius: Runs a loopback-only HTTP server in an in-process runspace and sends five POST beacons about two seconds apart with an uncommon user agent. No traffic leaves the host.
telemetry: Sysmon EID 3: connections to 127.0.0.1 on the beacon port
detection: NDR/EDR: periodic POSTs with a fixed body shape and unusual user agent

name: APT36 Collection 4 - Archive Staging with a Utility (T1560.001)
blast_radius: Archives five synthetic files with tar.exe into a run-tagged zip, lists it and extracts it to confirm every hash matches. Not encrypted. Removed and verified.
telemetry: Sysmon EID 1: tar.exe with a run-tagged archive path
detection: EDR: archive utility run on a collection folder by a script host

name: APT36 Lateral Movement 1 - Staging via the Loopback Administrative Share (T1021.002)
blast_radius: Gated by BAS_CONFIRM_APT36_REMOTE_STAGING=true (exact) and administrator only. Creates a run-tagged folder under C:/Users/Public through the loopback C$ share, copies three synthetic files into it, verifies them and removes the folder.
detection: SIEM: file writes over C$ from a non-administration host or process
cleanup:
Get-ChildItem -Path $env:TEMP -Filter 'bas_a36_*' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Get-ChildItem -Path (Join-Path $env:PUBLIC '.') -Filter 'bas_a36_*' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

name: APT36 Lateral Movement 2 - WinRM Exposure Check (T1021.006, read-only)
blast_radius: Reads whether the WinRM service is running and has a listener configured; never starts, stops or reconfigures WinRM. Entirely read-only.
telemetry: Sysmon EID 1: wsmprovhost.exe if remote PowerShell is later used
detection: SIEM: WinRM listener enabled where it should not be

name: APT36 Lateral Movement 3 - Remote Service Execution over SCM (T1569.002)
blast_radius: Gated by BAS_CONFIRM_APT36_LATERAL_MOVEMENT=true (exact), administrator only, and run only against hosts listed in BAS_LATERAL_TARGETS. On each target it creates a run-tagged demand-start service whose binary exits immediately, starts and stops it, then deletes it and verifies removal. Writes a persistent service record until the delete completes. Current identity only; no credentials are supplied or guessed. Built but not yet run against any lab target.
telemetry: System EID 7045: service installed on the target
Security EID 4697: service installed, if auditing is enabled
Sysmon EID 1: sc.exe with a remote \target argument
detection: EDR/SIEM: service created remotely from a non-administration source (Sigma service_install remote)
SIEM: run-tagged short-lived service fan-out across several hosts in one window
cleanup:
$tag = 'bas_a36_*'
ForEach ($t in @($env:BAS_LATERAL_TARGETS -split '[;,]' | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ -match '^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,253}$' })) { Get-Service -ComputerName $t -Name $tag -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { & (Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32\sc.exe') "\\$t" delete $_.Name | Out-Null } }

name: APT36 Lateral Movement 4 - Remote Scheduled Task over RPC (T1053.005)
blast_radius: Gated by BAS_CONFIRM_APT36_LATERAL_MOVEMENT=true (exact), administrator only, and run only against hosts in BAS_LATERAL_TARGETS. On each target it creates a run-tagged one-time task whose action writes one marker file under C:/Users/Public, queries it, deletes it and verifies the deletion. The task is never triggered by this step. Current identity only. Built but not yet run against any target.
telemetry: Security EID 4698 and 4699 on the target: task created and deleted
Task Scheduler EID 106 on the target
detection: SIEM: scheduled task created on a remote host by a non-administration source
EDR: schtasks /create /s from a workstation toward another workstation
cleanup:
$st = Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32\schtasks.exe'
ForEach ($t in @($env:BAS_LATERAL_TARGETS -split '[;,]' | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ -match '^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,253}$' })) { foreach ($line in @(& $st /query /s $t /fo csv /nh 2>$null)) { $n = ($line -split ',')[0].Trim('"'); if ($n -like '*bas_a36_*') { & $st /delete /s $t /tn $n /f | Out-Null } } }

name: APT36 C2 4 - DNS Tunneling Volume Pattern (T1071.004, telemetry)
blast_radius: Sends forty DNS TXT queries about 150 ms apart, each with a synthetic base32-style label under a run-tagged .invalid parent, from the PowerShell process. Queries go to the host resolver and cannot resolve. Validates host DNS telemetry for a high-volume pattern only.
telemetry: Sysmon EID 22: forty TXT queries with run-tagged parents
detection: DNS analytics: burst of long high-entropy labels under one parent domain
Resolver policy: .invalid names should never leave the resolver
